column3: With respect to the International Plaza Mortgage Loan (7.0%), Zara, the third largest tenant, has the right to terminate its lease as follows: (A) effective as of the expiration of the 60th full calendar month following the date tenant opened for business, and (B) effective as of the expiration of the 90th full calendar month following the date tenant opened for business, each with not less than 270 days’ notice, together with payment of a termination fee equal to the then-unamortized portion of tenant’s construction allowance. In addition, H&M, the fifth largest tenant, has a conditional right to terminate its lease if tenant’s gross sales are less than $7,000,000 for the fourth lease year with notice to landlord within 60 days of the date tenant is obligated to report its annual gross sales under the related lease. If exercised, the effective termination date is at the end of the fifth lease year, and tenant shall pay a termination fee equal to 50% of the unamortized portion of tenant’s construction allowance as of the effective termination date.
